values.note: ReserveAmerica (choose the Resident customer type for county pricing), by phone weekdays at Buildings & Grounds (607) 737-2843, or in person; 9-month rolling window, one site per date, paid in full at booking. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away. Visitors pay the daily entrance fee.

booking.source: https://www.chemungcountyny.gov/694/Park-Station ('9-month rolling window ... The minimum stay for weekends is 2 nights and the minimum stay for holidays is 3 nights'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days from April 1st through October 31st') + https://www.reserveamerica.com/explore/chemung-county-park-station-campground-and-rec-center/PRCG/1066350/overview (PARK RESERVATION INFORMATION, LENGTH OF STAY, VISITORS), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Water may be off in the campground and at the dump station before Memorial Day and after the last weekend in September.

season.source: https://www.reserveamerica.com/explore/chemung-county-park-station-campground-and-rec-center/PRCG/1066350/overview ('Camping is available from April 1 through October 31') + https://www.chemungcountyny.gov/DocumentCenter/View/17190/2025-Park-Station-Brochure ('Water may not be available in the campground or at the dump station before Memorial Day or after the last weekend in September'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 21 lakeside and 19 inside sites; the county measures each pad from the road to the back of the gravel at 42-100 ft.

sites.source: https://www.chemungcountyny.gov/694/Park-Station (site list, Site #1-#40 Lakeside/Inside) + https://www.chemungcountyny.gov/DocumentCenter/View/9333 ('Park Station Campsite Sizes ... measurement is taken from the road to the back of the gravel'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.chemungcountyny.gov/DocumentCenter/View/9333 ('Each campsite has electric (50 amp)') + https://www.chemungcountyny.gov/DocumentCenter/View/17190/2025-Park-Station-Brochure ('Each site includes Electric hookups (20, 30, 50 amp), Picnic table & fire ring, Nearby water taps'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.chemungcountyny.gov/DocumentCenter/View/17190/2025-Park-Station-Brochure ('Nearby water taps ... showers, laundry facilities, Bagged ice & worms for sale, Dumping station, Playgrounds') + ReserveAmerica overview ('Also available in the Park are flush toilets'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2026: Chemung County residents $27 inside / $29 lakeside; non-county $32 / $34. 2027: $29 / $31 county, $34 / $36 non-county. $3.50 non-refundable reservation fee and $3.50 change fee.

fees.source: https://www.chemungcountyny.gov/694/Park-Station ('2026 Camping Fees' and '2027 Camping Fees'; 'A $3.50 non-refundable reservation fee will be added to each reservation'), read 2026-10-21

note: Chemung County. Lakeside sites on a 100-acre lake. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 2026 fees $27-29 (+$5 non-county, $3.50 res fee), 40 sites, 50 A, phone 607-739-9164, ReserveAmerica. Added season Apr 1-Oct 31, 9-month window, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night max, booking URL, facilities (showers, flush toilets, laundry, dump, water taps), lakeside/inside split. Note trimmed of site count/electric/booking/season. Not stated: water/sewer at sites (water is from nearby taps), max rig length.
